reason: On my income 55 CZK for one can with less caffeine than my usual energy drink is hard to justify, when a pre-workout scoop or a can from GymBeam costs me a fraction of that. I might take a sip if a friend had one at a café, but I wouldn't order it.
objection: 80 mg is less than what I normally take before training, so I'd be paying more for a weaker kick and I doubt I'd even feel it.
would_change_my_mind: A free sample or a multipack on Vilgain or GymBeam at around 35 CZK a can, so I could try it before a long ride without paying café prices.
